prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: Fanggu heritage line plate. Image 1 is documentary SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY for Nishi Hongan-ji Hiunkaku, the actual asymmetrical three-storey pavilion in the supplied photograph. Preserve three unequal staggered levels, offset upper tier, varied roof forms, broad lower veranda and slender posts; do not turn it into the gold Kinkaku or silver Ginkaku. Show the whole pavilion and a minimal ground line, remove garden foliage and pond clutter. Image 2 is ONLY the project's delicate fine black ink line style sample, never a subject-shape reference. Create a refined sparse BLACK INK architectural contour drawing on perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF background. Whole building centered, approximately straight-on, generous margins, landscape 1536x1024, roof/apex and base uncut. Fine neutral black contours and restrained structural detail; white unmarked inside and outside the subject. No colored fill, gray shading, cast shadow, gradient, paper grain, glow, checkerboard, lettering, labels, tourists, frame or watermark.
